The best available dataset does not include comments where the flag code is <0 (data outside sensor limits; rejected data; missing data;
and optional supported data that were not collected).  If you wish to export all this data you must choose the All Inclusive Data button.
Please refer to the Read Me document bundled in the WinRAR file for important information regarding data QAQC and data file contents.
After quarterly data QC and submission; an abbreviated metadata document will also be available detailing specific project information, station data collection methods,
Temp: water temperature measured in degrees Celsius (C)
SpCond: specific conductivity measured in milli-Siemens per centimeter (mS/cm)
pH: pH measured in standard units
Sal: salinity measured in parts per thousand (psu)
Depth: sonde depth measured in meters (m)
Turb: turbidity measured in either formazin nephelometric or nephelometric turbidity units (FNU/NTU) based on sensor
DO_pct: dissolved oxygen measured in percent saturation (%)
DO_mgl: dissolved oxygen concentration measured in milligrams per Liter (mg/L)
ChlFluor: chlorophyll fluorescence measured in micrograms per Liter (ug/L) (optional parameter)

Historical: A value of 0 in the historical column indicates that the data have not been through the final QAQC by the FSUCML information manager. A value of 1 indicates that the data have been through
final tertiary review and posted as the final authoritative data.

Provisional Plus: A value of 0 in the provisional plus column indicates that the data have been through the automated flagging process (primary QAQC) ONLY and have not been checked by the FSUCML information manager.
While a value of 1 in the provisional plus column indicates that the data have been through secondary QAQC at the FSUCML using Excel macros (provided by the CDMO) to further QAQC the data.
Each required parameter in the dataset is followed by a flag column (where the parameter header is preceded by a F_).
